fields.description: The base identity this delta targets, or the reference of a brand-new user pin (ADR-0023): a bare app, a dashboard, an applet, or a doctype + view.

fields.description: The moved position (an edge-anchored desktop cell {column, row} or a 1-D dock {order}); absent for a hide. Never raw pixels (ADR-0023).
